heroSubtitle.label: Hero Subtitle
heroSubtitle.value: We work with ambitious young people — 16 to 25 — who are ready to lead but need the right structure, the right mentors, and the right room to grow. That's what we build.

missionTitle.label: Mission Title
missionTitle.value: Built for the People Who Come Next

missionBodyOne.label: Mission Body One
missionBodyOne.value: We're a nonprofit that develops young leaders. Not through inspiration posters and one-day workshops, but through real programs with clear structure — and the expectation that participants will do the work.

missionBodyTwo.label: Mission Body Two
missionBodyTwo.value: We believe potential is everywhere. The right conditions for it are not. Our job is to build those conditions, then get out of the way.

programsLead.label: Programs Lead
programsLead.value: Four programs. Each one built around what young leaders actually need — not what looks good in a brochure.

quoteHtml.label: Quote
quoteHtml.value:
"The world doesn't need more followers.
It needs leaders who know why they lead."

joinMovementBody.label: Join Movement Body
joinMovementBody.value: Whether you want to join a program, mentor someone, or put money behind work that actually matters — we'll find the right fit.

donateCtaTitle.label: Donate CTA Title
donateCtaTitle.value:
Every Rand You Give
Builds a Leader

donateCtaBody.label: Donate CTA Body
donateCtaBody.value: Scholarships, mentorship, and grants for young people doing real work. That's where your money goes.

heroIntro.label: Hero Intro
heroIntro.value: The NexGen Leaders Foundation (NGL) is a non-profit company led by young professionals and emerging leaders who are committed to empowering youth in the Southern Suburbs.

storyBodyOne.label: Story Body One
storyBodyOne.value: NexGen Leaders Foundation began with a simple but powerful realization: there is an abundance of talent in our local schools, but a shortage of the guidance needed to unlock it.

storyBodyTwo.label: Story Body Two
storyBodyTwo.value: In early 2026, the foundation was established by Amber Dreyer and Michai Mentor. They saw recurring gaps in the Southern Suburbs, where ambitious students had potential but not always a clear roadmap into higher education and professional opportunities.

storyBodyThree.label: Story Body Three
storyBodyThree.value: What started as a shared vision for getting the underprivileged educated evolved into a structured movement that pairs mentorship, leadership development, and community support for students who need it most.

focusSchoolsBody.label: Focus Schools Body
focusSchoolsBody.value: Steenberg High School, Sibelius High School, Crestway High School, Lavender Hill High School, Heathfield High School, and Pelican Park High School.

missionText.label: Mission Text
missionText.value: Through real programs, honest mentorship, access to funding, and a community that stays active long after formal programs end.

visionText.label: Vision Text
visionText.value: A future where every young person has access to guidance, opportunity, and a clear pathway to success, regardless of background or circumstance.

heroIntro.label: Hero Intro
heroIntro.value: Each program is built around what young leaders actually need at a specific stage — structured enough to deliver real outcomes, flexible enough to meet people where they are.

introBodyOne.label: Intro Body One
introBodyOne.value: Too many leadership programs are built around inspiration — good speakers, a certificate, a day that felt energising and changed nothing. We're not interested in that.

introBodyTwo.label: Intro Body Two
introBodyTwo.value: Every NexGen program has clear outcomes, measurable milestones, and real expectations. Participants leave with actual work in their portfolios, actual relationships in their corner, and a clearer picture of what they're capable of.

heroTitle.label: Hero Title
heroTitle.value:
Driven by People
Who Believe in People

heroIntro.label: Hero Intro
heroIntro.value: Our team brings together expertise in education, community development, communications, and social finance — all united by a genuine belief that what we're building matters.

heroIntro.label: Hero Intro
heroIntro.value: How to engage is simple: apply as a student, register as a mentor, volunteer your skills, or partner with us to strengthen youth leadership in our communities.

pageIntro.label: Page Intro
pageIntro.value: We run two application intakes each year. If applications are closed when you apply, your submission is held for the next review round and you will receive updates by email.

intakeCalloutBody.label: Intake Callout Body
intakeCalloutBody.value: Intake 1: February to March. Intake 2: August to September. Early applications are encouraged.

heroIntro.label: Hero Intro
heroIntro.value: Questions about our programs, a partnership idea, a donation enquiry, or just something you want to say — our team reads every message and responds to all of them.

impactIntro.label: Impact Intro
impactIntro.value: Our goal is to direct the majority of donations into mentorship, academic support, and youth leadership development for students in our focus schools.
